name: Editorial Bold
thesis: Monochrome magazine-cover drama — near-black on near-white, huge high-contrast serif display type, night-photography carousel hero.
fontSubstitutionNote: Source uses commercial fonts Didot LT Std + Gilroy, self-hosted and not open-licensed. Substituted with Playfair Display (free, closest high-contrast Didone) + Jost (free, closest geometric-grotesk to Gilroy). Flagged, not silent.

forks.paletteMood: monochrome — near-black (#111) on near-white (#fafafa), no color accent
forks.typePairing: Playfair Display (display, uppercase, wide-tracked, heavy) + Jost (body) — substitutes for Didot/Gilroy
forks.heroTreatment: dark night-photography, slideshow/carousel with a progress underline, cover-line headline treatment
forks.density: slightly more generous (1.15x) — editorial magazine breathing room
forks.surface: sharp — 0px radius, no shadow, hard edges throughout
forks.motionPersonality: dramatic — .9s, more pronounced reveal distance and stagger
